containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
echo "===I3577E_START utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache postgresql16-client curl jq openssl bind-tools netcat-openbsd >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1
GEO=$(curl -s -m 20 http://ip-api.com/json/); echo "GEO $GEO"
echo "$GEO" | grep -q '"countryCode":"CN"' && { echo "ABORT_CN_EGRESS"; exit 0; }

echo "########## MLFLOW ALB REACHABILITY (from inside VPC) ##########"
H=lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-mlf-1648160050.us-west-2.elb.amazonaws.com
echo "DNS $(getent hosts $H | awk '{print $1}' | head -1)"
for P in 80 443; do
  timeout 8 sh -c "echo > /dev/tcp/$H/$P" 2>/dev/null && echo "TCP $P OPEN" || echo "TCP $P CLOSED"
done
for U in "https://$H/health" "https://$H/" "http://$H/health"; do
  printf '%-46s -> ' "$U"; curl -sk -m 15 -o /tmp/o -w '%{http_code} len=%{size_download}\n' "$U" 2>&1
  head -c 200 /tmp/o 2>/dev/null; echo
done
echo "-- with Host: mlflow.stage01.lazamedical.ai"
curl -sk -m 15 -o /tmp/o2 -w 'health=%{http_code} len=%{size_download}\n' -H "Host: mlflow.stage01.lazamedical.ai" "https://$H/health"; head -c 200 /tmp/o2; echo
curl -sk -m 20 -o /tmp/o3 -w 'explist=%{http_code} len=%{size_download}\n' -H "Host: mlflow.stage01.lazamedical.ai" "https://$H/api/2.0/mlflow/experiments/list?max_results=5"; head -c 500 /tmp/o3; echo
curl -sk -m 20 -o /tmp/o4 -w 'rmlist=%{http_code} len=%{size_download}\n' -H "Host: mlflow.stage01.lazamedical.ai" "https://$H/api/2.0/mlflow/registered-models/list"; head -c 400 /tmp/o4; echo
echo "########## PROXY PROTOCOL DIAGNOSTIC ##########"
P=lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-postgresql1-proxy.proxy-cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com
echo "-- dns"
getent hosts $P
echo "-- dig CNAME"
( command -v dig >/dev/null && dig +short $P A; dig +short $P CNAME ) 2>&1 | head -6
echo "-- netcat banner read (5s)"
timeout 6 nc -w 5 $P 5432 < /dev/null | xxd | head -3
echo "-- openssl starttls postgres (full)"
( echo | timeout 20 openssl s_client -connect $P:5432 -starttls postgres -state -msg 2>&1 ) | head -30
echo "===I3577E_DONE $(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
